inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement or face an indefinite nationwide strike. The government should keep its obligations, but a union’s demands do not justify holding students’ education and families’ plans hostage. Universities are institutions of learning, not bargaining weapons. Both sides should act with discipline, respect their responsibilities, and settle this before young people bear the cost of another disruption.
